Questions

Common questions.

How much overlap is there with US and UK working hours?

Nairobi is UTC+3: the full UK and European working day overlaps, and US East Coast mornings overlap with our afternoons.

Who owns the code?

You do. Code, data and infrastructure accounts belong to your company.

Can we start small?

Yes. Most clients start with one scoped project, then keep the team for ongoing work.
